def predict_with_threshold(grid_h, grid_w, red_row, inputs):
    """Apply threshold-based expansion"""

def diagonal_beams(r, c, grid_h, grid_w, red_row):
    """Create diagonal beams from input"""
    outputs = set()
    
    # Up-left beam (-1,-1 direction)
    nr, nc = r - 1, c - 1

        if nr < red_row:  # Above red line

        else:

        nr -= 1
        nc -= 1

    while nr < grid_h and nc < grid_w:
        if nr < red_row:  # Above red line

        else:

        nr += 1
        nc += 1

# Hypothesis: From input(s), extend FULL diagonals until hitting bounds
def full_diagonals_from_inputs(inputs, red_row, grid_h, grid_w):
    """Extend both diagonals from each input until hitting grid bounds"""
    out = set()
    
    for r_in, c_in in inputs:
        # Center
        out.add((r_in, c_in))
        
        # Up-left diagonal
        nr, nc = r_in - 1, c_in - 1
        while nr >= 0 and nc >= 0:
            # Stay above red if we started above red
            if r_in < red_row and nr >= red_row:
                break
            out.add((nr, nc))
            nr -= 1
            nc -= 1
        
        # Down-right diagonal  
        nr, nc = r_in + 1, c_in + 1
        while nr < grid_h and nc < grid_w:
            # Stay below red if we started below red
            if r_in > red_row and nr <= red_row:
                break
            out.add((nr, nc))
            nr += 1
            nc += 1
    
    return sorted(out)

# Test: Combine two diagonal chains per input - one going toward red, one away

def dual_chains(r_in, c_in, red_row, grid_h, grid_w):
    """Two diagonal chains: one toward red, one extending away"""
    out = set()
    
    # Chain toward red
    if r_in < red_row:
        # Going down along diagonals toward red
        for dc in [-1, 1]:
            nr, nc = r_in + 1, c_in + dc
            while nr < red_row and 0 <= nr < grid_h and 0 <= nc < grid_w:
                out.add((nr, nc))
                nr += 1
                nc += dc
    else:
        # Going up toward red
        for dc in [-1, 1]:
            nr, nc = r_in - 1, c_in + dc
            while nr > red_row and 0 <= nr < grid_h and 0 <= nc < grid_w:
                out.add((nr, nc))
                nr -= 1
                nc += dc
    
    # Chain extending away (opposite direction)
    if r_in < red_row:
        # Going up away from red
        for dc in [-1, 1]:
            nr, nc = r_in - 1, c_in + dc
            while nr >= 0 and 0 <= nr < grid_h and 0 <= nc < grid_w:
                out.add((nr, nc))
                nr -= 1
                nc += dc
    else:
        # Going down away from red
        for dc in [-1, 1]:
            nr, nc = r_in + 1, c_in + dc
            while nr < grid_h and 0 <= nr < grid_h and 0 <= nc < grid_w:
                out.add((nr, nc))
                nr += 1
                nc += dc
    
    out.add((r_in, c_in))
    return sorted(out)
